title: At the Summit of Apocrypha
description: The final confrontation with Miraak in Apocrypha. After learning the final word of Bend Will from Hermaeus Mora, the Dragonborn must read the Black Book Waking Dreams, traverse the chapters of Apocrypha, tame the dragon Sahrotaar, and defeat Miraak at his temple to end his threat to Solstheim.

base_facts: I am the First Dragonborn, and I have hidden in Apocrypha for ages.
Hermaeus Mora kept me trapped here, but I will find a way to return to Solstheim.
The Dragonborn's soul is the final key I need to escape Apocrypha.
I command dragons Kruziikrel and Relonikiv, and the serpent dragon Sahrotaar.

DEFEAT_MIRAAK: Miraak has been defeated and absorbed back into Apocrypha by Hermaeus Mora.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Miraak is gone and will never threaten Solstheim again.

base_facts: I am Hermaeus Mora, Daedric Prince of Knowledge and Fate.
I granted the final Word of Power for Bend Will, at the cost of Storn Crag-Strider's life.
Miraak has served his purpose. His time in Apocrypha is done.
I am Sahrotaar, a serpentine dragon bound to Miraak's will in Apocrypha.
The Bend Will shout can break Miraak's hold over me.

TAME_SAHROTAAR: Sahrotaar has been tamed by the Dragonborn's Bend Will shout and will carry them to Miraak's tower.

beats.comment: Player unlocks the Bend Will shout after Hermaeus Mora teaches the final word, killing Storn.
Player reads the Black Book Waking Dreams to enter Apocrypha.
Player traverses the chapters of Apocrypha and reaches Miraak's Temple.
Player uses the full Bend Will shout to tame the serpentine dragon Sahrotaar.
Player confronts and defeats Miraak at the summit. Miraak becomes invulnerable and sacrifices dragons before Hermaeus Mora claims him.
Quest finishes. Miraak is defeated, his equipment is left behind, and Solstheim is freed.
